Seam index in the join context; oneOf picks per seam (rich-joiners-9ntp.bex) (#386)

* Seam index in the join context; oneOf picks per seam (rich-joiners-9ntp.bex)

Joiner.join takes { index }: the join before item i is i, the end after
the last of n items is n. FlexStrip passes the same index at a wrap, so
every surviving seam keeps its glyph. CellJoiner hashes (index, cell
offset) to pick a oneOf member.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
